what: Mohawk is the world's largest flooring manufacturer: carpet, ceramic tile, laminate, vinyl and wood flooring, sold under Mohawk, Daltile, Quick-Step, Pergo and Karastan.
customers: Flooring retailers, home centres, builders and commercial contractors worldwide.
moat: Manufacturing close to its markets in a product too bulky to ship far, with brands specified by builders and retailers across every flooring category.
risks: Flooring demand follows house moves and renovation, both depressed by interest rates
Revenue has fallen from $11.7B to $10.8B and has not recovered
A 3.4% net margin in a capital-heavy manufacturing business
opportunities: 9.3 times free cash flow with $892M of free cash flow against an $8.3B market value
$856M of cash against $2.5B of debt and the company buys back stock
Flooring is replaced when people move, so pent-up demand builds while moves are postponed
watch: Volume growth separate from price, and the operating margin by segment.
